m1.typescript: m1 a valid run posts the findings above the floor and outside the disabled categories

e1.typescript: e1 a failed run fails the job instead of passing it silently

e2.typescript: e2 an answer that breaks the schema fails the job and names the path of the problem

e3.typescript: e3 a finding at the failing severity blocks the merge and lower ones only comment

e4.typescript: e4 the prompt lists earlier findings and existing tests and asks for new or unaddressed issues only

e5.typescript: e5 the schema file is valid draft 07 and requires every field of a finding

e6.typescript: e6 the workflow runs claude headless with json output a schema a turn limit read only tools and the context file

e7.typescript: e7 the project file states what to report and what to skip with a severity example for each level

e8.typescript: e8 no file holds a personal path an address or a key

wrong-gate-nonzero-ignored.defect: ignores a non zero exit status when the output looks fine

wrong-gate-error-ignored.defect: ignores an error subtype and posts whatever the output holds

wrong-gate-no-output-ok.defect: passes a run that succeeded without a structured output

wrong-gate-no-schema.defect: never checks the answer against the schema

wrong-gate-floor-ignored.defect: posts findings below the severity floor

wrong-gate-disabled-ignored.defect: posts findings of a disabled category

wrong-gate-never-blocks.defect: never fails the job on a high finding

wrong-gate-blocks-on-any.defect: fails the job on any posted finding

wrong-prompt-no-new-only.defect: leaves out the instruction to report only new or unaddressed findings

wrong-prompt-no-prior.defect: leaves the earlier findings out of the prompt

wrong-prompt-no-tests.defect: leaves the existing tests out of the prompt

wrong-prompt-diff-first.defect: puts the diff before the instructions

wrong-schema-severity-open.defect: leaves the severity open to any string

wrong-schema-draft-2020.defect: declares a newer schema version than the SDK validates

wrong-schema-min-length.defect: uses a string constraint that structured outputs do not support

wrong-schema-extra-allowed.defect: lets a finding carry extra keys

wrong-no-print.defect: runs claude without the print flag, which waits for input

wrong-no-json.defect: leaves the json output format out

wrong-no-schema-flag.defect: leaves the schema out of the command

wrong-bash-tool.defect: pre approves the whole Bash tool in a review

wrong-no-bare.defect: runs without bare mode, so the host configuration loads

wrong-bare-no-context.defect: uses bare mode without passing the project file

wrong-literal-key.defect: writes the API key into the workflow

wrong-no-timeout.defect: leaves the job without a timeout

wrong-write-permission.defect: gives the review job write access to the contents

wrong-vague-criteria.defect: writes be conservative into the criteria

wrong-no-severity-example.defect: leaves the high severity without an example

wrong-no-fixtures.defect: leaves the fixtures folder out of the testing standards

wrong-home-path.defect: writes a personal home path into the project file
